### 2026-10-06 — Team chat and a live Messages page (his "messages must be owner and the employees as well … toggle for client and employees … attachment … picture … voice … notification icon … notification sound … Ajax based runtime")
Design: `docs/TEAM-CHAT-DESIGN.md` (the audit, the decisions, the review in §9, the known limits in §10). Read as: "owner" = the
account owner in the back office, "employees" = the staff, "client" = guests; unit owners keep their own conversations.
- **Team chat has its own tables** — never `message_threads`: a guest thread belongs to the organisation (one shared unread counter,
  every `guests.view` holder reads it); a team conversation belongs to its members, each with their own read position (a message id).
  Sharing the table would have needed a "not team" filter at every guest-Inbox read site.
- **Every back-office user may use it** (the `/app` group's back-office gate; no new permission, so the RBAC pins stay). Only members
  see a conversation, its messages or its files — a 404 for anyone else. A support (break-glass) session cannot open it, and its bell
  entries are left out of the support session's bell, feed and counts.
- **Live means polling** (shared hosting: no websockets, no Redis): the open conversation every 3 s (20 s hidden), the open Inbox's
  stamp every 5 s (30 s hidden), every back-office page's pulse every 20 s (60 s hidden); nothing after 30 minutes without a key or a
  click; signed out stops it, a busy or failing server only slows it. Named rate limits per purpose (`team-chat-poll` 120,
  `team-chat-write` 40, `pulse` 60, `inbox-live` 60 a minute, per person).
- **Reading is the person's act.** The Inbox's live refresh reads nothing (`live=1`); the page posts `app.inbox.read` for a
  conversation the person opened (never a preview), only while they are at the page; team chat reads up to what the page was shown,
  only while the person is there. Sending reads nothing.
- **Notifications are in-app only, one per conversation**, naming people, never the text: a teammate's message rings the other
  members who still work here; a guest's or an owner's rings the assignee, else everyone with `guests.view`. A guest's erasure deletes
  the staff's bell entries naming their conversations (and the older assignment entry, which named them too).
- **Sound is synthesised in the browser** (no file), on unless switched off, only after the person's first click or key.
- **Files:** pictures, documents (the owner chat's list) and one voice note of up to 3 minutes; the type is judged by the file's own
  bytes and a download carries the extension its bytes earned; this server's own upload ceilings are read and said
  (`ChatFiles::limits()`). Guests and owners receive them where they can open them: an owner's portal, a guest's Direct conversation
  (their guest account); refused on Booking.com, Airbnb, WhatsApp and email. A reply's files are kept on the disk before it is sent.
- **The microphone** is allowed on the two Messages pages only (`microphone=(self)`); `media-src 'self' blob:` lets a recording be
  heard before it is sent.
- **In the Inbox, Enter is a new line and Ctrl/⌘+Enter sends** (these replies go to guests and owners); in team chat Enter sends.

**Gates (Verified 2026-10-06):** **4,480/4,480 on MySQL 8.4.10** (32,952 assertions; 17:38–17:58 Baku) · **4,480/4,480 on MariaDB 11.8.9** (32,952 assertions; 18:00–18:19 Baku) — both on tree `0b3f80cfe6b338b6` (the code before one Blade comment was corrected and these docs written) and read from the runs' JUnit logs: 0 failed, 0 errors, 0 skipped · PHPStan L5 0 errors (a whole run, 31 s at 18:21 Baku, from a result cache deleted by hand — a run under the output wrapper had read the old cache in 0 s) · Pint clean (the changed files) · money gate FULL `929 / 10928000 / 0 / 42 / 16 / 0`, digest unchanged (V 17:59 Baku, reseeded 17:58). Mutations: the whole harness re-run on the final code — **1,005/1,005 landed and caught across all 36 sets** (`team-chat` 29 and `inbox-live` 28 new; V 18:21–18:53 Baku); 0 not caught, 0 did not land.

## 2026-10-24 — Security, both pages: his design on one kit, a score derived from real settings, real sign-in problems, and login approval that cannot lock anyone out

**Ask (F, 2026-10-24):** his screenshot of the `Owner Security.html` wireframe — "this is what is missing inside our security page … plz audit
it and give me some planning … once i approved then start building it". **Ruled (F, the same day):** "Both pages (Recommended)" and "All of it
(Recommended)" — three parts in two deploys (Parts 1+2, then 3).

**Decided in the build, each with its reason:**
- **One score, one rule** (`App\Support\Security\SecurityScore`): password 25 · two-factor 30 · recovery codes 15 · passkey 15 · login approval 10
  · login alerts 5. Only protections the account can turn on count, sharing the 100 by largest remainder — so a missing channel never marks
  anyone down, and the ring and the rows add up. The owner page's old 40/40/20 is replaced (its test moved with it, said to him).
- **Login approval switches ON only while email is really sent** (`MailSafetyGuard::sendingNow()`); OFF always. Its approval link is an
  email; with production's mailer `log`, a held sign-in could never finish. Found by this pass's audit (`docs/memory/OPEN.md`
  D-LOGIN-APPROVAL-MAIL).
- **Sign-in problems are LOCKOUTS on the person's own address** (`login_activity`, `guard = web`, 90 days), dismissed by "This was me"
  (`users.security_alerts_seen_at`). ⚠️ The `login_activity` migration recorded its access as admin-only; the card shows a person the lockouts
  on their own address — his call whether that stays (`OPEN.md` D-SX-IP), and whether the IP is shown depends on it being the visitor's (measured
  at the deploy).
- **Refused as fabrication (#39):** place names, "trusted locations", SMS, re-showing recovery codes, sample apps — `DIVERGENCE-REGISTER.md`.

**Proof:** `SecurityRedesignTest` (15), `SecurityPassFiveTest` rewritten to the new layout, mutation sets `security-redesign` 25/25 and
`security-five` 22/22; the independent review's points fixed or recorded (`docs/memory/HISTORY.md`, "SECURITY REDESIGN"). Gates and the
deploy are recorded in `docs/memory/STATE.md`.

**Part 3, the same day (2026-10-24/25):** login alerts made real (the "Login from a new device" switch had sent nothing — staff switch it,
an owner's is always on as the owner settings promised), the session timeout (15 / 30 / 60 minutes; a page polling by itself never counts
as the person), "password last changed" (dated by the User model on every path), and login approval on the back office with Approve / Deny of
a waiting sign-in from a signed-in device on both pages — one `AccountSecurityController` for both realms. `SecurityProtectionsTest` (13),
mutations `security-protections` 14/14.

## 2026-11-14 — DEC-2 confirmed: per-unit public price; tax rates when the first customer arrives

**Ruling (Founder said, 2026-11-14, "Lets do this" on two choices laid out in a table):** (1) the public price is **per unit** — each room, apartment or villa costs a fixed amount per month (it fits operators with a mix of hotels, apartments and villas; the billing page already works this way); (2) tax rates are **set when the first customer arrives** — the rate for that customer's country, with the accountant; with 0 customers there is nothing to compute.

## 2026-11-14 — Booking terms, option B (D-BOOK-NO-TERMS): a required box, terms built from the property's real settings, a stored proof, a guest privacy notice

**Ruling (Founder said, 2026-11-14):** "for the booking terms, we don't need lawyer. You find the best option and give me the option, I will approve and you can work on it." — then "Ok B is fine, go ahead." Scope: the checkout's booking terms and the guest privacy notice ONLY; F6's other questions (Article 28, who may hold customers' money, retention periods) are unchanged and the notice names no retention period.

**Decision:** the guest must tick a required, unticked box before paying; the terms are built by ONE builder (`BookingTerms`) from what the property actually set plus the hotel's own plain text; the version shown travels in the form and a mismatch refuses the booking; the proof (time, version, the terms as shown — no guest data) is written on the reservation in the same transaction; the JSON booking endpoint requires `terms_accepted`; the guest privacy notice states only what the system does. **Why not A or C:** A (a link, no box) cannot prove agreement; C (a full editor per language with versions and a PDF) waits until hotels ask.

**What a session must not do with this:** never loosen the box, the version check or the JSON rule to make a test or a client pass (fix the fixture); never claim a refund percentage or a retention period on these pages; never render the hotel's text unescaped.

**Found on the way (pre-existing):** Settings → Policies refused every save from the real screen since 2026-07-31 (OPEN `D-SETTINGS-POLICIES-SILENT-FAIL`).

## 2026-11-14 — No more waiting for the lawyer: the founder decides, in writing, and the entries say so

**Ruling (Founder said, 2026-11-14):** "Yes, go ahead with all of your recommendation. but I don't want to wait for lawyer for anything. So go for the best options."

**What this changed in code:**
- **The money records' retention period** is decided by the founder, without legal advice: **10 years** (the longest period commonly required by EU accounting rules, so nothing is deleted too early). One constant (`RetentionDecisions::FINANCIAL_RECORDS_YEARS`), 14 registry entries, each stating it was the founder's own call. The old guard that pinned the registry EMPTY was replaced by one that pins what is true now: every shipped decision complete, dated 2026-11-14, attributed, naming a real table. `audit_events` / `domain_events` are deliberately NOT decided (staff IP addresses).
- **The "Delete my account" card** now states the period definitely instead of "may have to be kept".
- **Retired:** the standing instruction "never fill `RetentionDecisions::DECISIONS` without the lawyer's written period" (2026-11-13 entry) — superseded by this ruling.

**What a session must not do with this:** never present these periods as legal advice (the entries say they are not); never extend the "no lawyer" reading to money movement, live Stripe or deleting an organisation (rules 3 and 4 stand); never decide a store the founder has not decided; when counsel is engaged, change the ONE constant and the card's words together (the test fails until both agree).
